summary.text: Andrew Duck is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran, he has worked as director of operations for Avertica and founded the organization Frederick Cares, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Duck graduated from Middletown High School and served in the U.S. Army, according to Ballotpedia.
His career includes work as director of operations for Avertica, and he founded the organization Frederick Cares.
Duck ran in the Democratic primary for Maryland's 6th Congressional District in 2018 and finished fifth with 4.9 percent of the vote.

He ran for the Maryland House of Delegates in District 4 in 2022, advancing from the Democratic primary and receiving 15.2 percent in the general election, which was not enough to win one of the three seats.
In 2026, he again advanced from the Democratic primary, finishing first among the candidates with 28.3 percent.
